subject: HEXOS-2: launcher icon grid as a second view over the manifest
description:
Icons, categories, search, recents. Its real job is falsification: if the grid needs data the manifest lacks, the manifest is wrong. Build after HEXOS-3 so it never renders unverified entries.
[2026-08-31 15:58] Verified live 2026-08-31: /hex/apps.html HTTP 200, 190 apps over the same manifest as the shell.
